claims.statement: Durable knowledge is split into two layers: prescriptive guidance (agent behavior, procedures) lives under .agents/ as plain markdown, while descriptive knowledge (facts, rationale, decisions, troubleshooting) lives as curated OKF pages under openwiki/{decisions,troubleshooting}/ plus curated root pages overview.md and maintenance-format.md; ephemeral task evidence lives under .agents/sessions/.

.agents/AGENTS.md contains routing directives (upon startup read openwiki/index.md and .agents/AGENTS.md; when debugging grep openwiki/ .agents/ first; before architectural changes search openwiki/decisions/), project learnings (short distilled rules), and self-improvement loop summary, and must stay small; lessons are promoted there only when high-confidence, broadly useful, likely to recur, concise, and actionable.

Root AGENTS.md is a stacked marker-delimited file with isolated ownership: FerroxLabs baseline (AKSK:AGENTS-BASELINE) owned by init_agents_md.mjs/refresh_agents_baseline.mjs, OpenWiki block (OPENWIKI:START/END) owned by OpenWiki tooling, AKSK Routing (AKSK:ROUTING) and Lifecycle (AKSK:LIFECYCLE) owned by attach_section.mjs; a fully bootstrapped file contains all three families ordered baseline → OpenWiki → AKSK, refreshing one zone never rewrites another and each zone is validated independently.

Curated wiki trees are openwiki/decisions/, openwiki/troubleshooting/, openwiki/overview.md and openwiki/maintenance-format.md; all pages under them are authored directly by the distilling agent/maintainer in OKF format and are never written by openwiki --update, while openwiki/index.md and directory index.md catalogs plus .last-update.json/.run.json are OpenWiki-owned generated files that must never be hand-edited.

For every decision/troubleshooting entry file the filename stem is the entry identity, must be lowercase [a-z0-9_-] and unique within its tree; filenames carry no type prefix and disambiguation lives in qualified references decisions/<slug> or troubleshooting/<slug> and relative Markdown links.

Curated pages carry OKF base frontmatter type/title/description/tags/timestamp plus AKSK extensions: aksk_status required on decisions (accepted|superseded|provisional), optional aksk_superseded_by (successor slug with paired relative link), optional aksk_depends_on (list of qualified decisions/<slug> or troubleshooting/<slug>); schemas at .agents/skills/learning-distill/references/*.schema.json allow additional aksk_* properties and runtime validation uses openwiki/dist/okf/frontmatter.js validateOkfFrontmatter.

If a candidate lesson restates a SHALL requirement already codified in openspec/specs/, distillation must not create or extend a wiki page for it and must cite the spec capability instead; wiki pages record facts and rationale while requirements live only in OpenSpec.

The curation contract lives inside openwiki/INSTRUCTIONS.md between AKSK:WIKI-CONTRACT:BEGIN/END markers and is owned by .agents/skills/aksk-bootstrap/scripts/attach_wiki_contract.mjs which appends the template from references/wiki-contract-template.md below existing content, never creates the file, never removes OpenWiki content, is idempotent and self-updating (re-running is a no-op unless template changed, then only between markers); if INSTRUCTIONS.md does not exist it exits 2 with openwiki --init prerequisite and no writes.

Preserve-and-link semantics: when openwiki --update would regenerate a page under a curated tree the AKSK-authored page is kept and generated material links to it, and all aksk_* frontmatter fields survive round-trips; distill-authored pages bypass the CLI and distillation must fail closed before any wiki write when the contract markers are absent, otherwise curated pages could be silently regenerated away.

.agents/playbooks/ holds durable multi-step procedures; shipped examples include pre-publish.md, major-version-release.md and writing-integration-guides.md, written only by learning-distill for procedural lessons.

Per-task closeout bundles live under .agents/sessions/YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-short-topic/ and each contains exactly five files: summary.json, active-task.md, learning-candidate.md, changed-files.txt, validation.txt; .agents/.gitignore contains sessions/* and !sessions/README.md so only README.md is tracked, bundles are immutable after closeout except distilled/distillation_status in summary.json, and canonical identity is task_id from summary.json not the folder name.

Session bundles are gitignored and therefore invisible to ignore-aware searches; distillation must locate them via ignore-blind methods (ls/find or rg --no-ignore-vcs) and filter by task_id and summary.json state fields; troubleshooting entry session-discovery-fails-during-distillation-or-closeout documents this failure mode.

Supersession is expressed by aksk_status: superseded plus aksk_superseded_by pointing at the successor slug with a relative link; the frontmatter is authoritative and listings add secondary locks bold [SUPERSEDED] prefix and strikethrough, replacing the former triple-lock/log bookkeeping.

Distillation never invokes openwiki --update; after passing fail-closed checks (check_peer_tools.mjs verifies openspec and openwiki on PATH with exact npm install remediation, and contract markers present) it authors pages directly using runtime guidance from openwiki/dist/agent/prompt.js createSystemPrompt and validates with validateOkfFrontmatter, then deterministically refreshes indexes via sync_wiki_indexes.mjs which locates the global package via npm root -g, constructs OpenWikiLocalShellBackend with docsOnly:true virtualMode:true and calls synchronizeWikiIndexes, keeping curated bodies byte-identical.

Accounts for consolidation: .agents/docs/, hand-built indexes (decisions/index.md etc.) and .agents/docs/log.md were deleted by knowledge-consolidation-into-openwiki; distilled accountability now lives in session bundle summary.json flags plus git history with no separate log file.

Single-writer invariants: task-closeout writes only under .agents/sessions/, learning-distill alone writes curated wiki trees/.agents/AGENTS.md/playbooks, docs-lint never writes OpenWiki-owned files; validation uses bash scripts/check-agents-structure.sh for portable shape and bash scripts/check-publish.sh for release hygiene, with docs-lint wiring checks for contract presence, superseded mismatches, dead aksk_depends_on and zone marker integrity.
